name: Amazon Product Advertising API
tagline: Amazon product catalog search, pricing, and affiliate links via Product Advertising API 5.0
description: Amazon Product Advertising API (PA-API 5.0) lets registered Associates search Amazon's product catalog, retrieve item details, offers, images, and browse nodes, and generate affiliate-tracked links. Access requires an Amazon Associates account that meets program eligibility rules and approved API credentials. Requests use AWS Signature Version 4 over HTTPS to regional endpoints.

auth.details: AWS Signature Version 4 with Access Key and Secret Key from Associates Central; also requires Partner Tag (Store ID). Not a simple API key header.

pricing.free_tier_limits: No usage fees; access gated by Associates account status and performance (e.g. qualifying sales). Rate/throughput limits apply; exact free request quotas not a classic freemium tier.
pricing.paid_plans: No paid API plans; monetized via Associates referral commissions, not per-request API billing.

rate_limits: Account-based; starts low and scales with revenue (commonly cited: 1 TPD initially, increases with shipped-item revenue). Exact current formula in official docs / account dashboard.
use_cases: search Amazon products by keyword and get ASINs
get product title, price, and image for an ASIN
build affiliate product links with partner tag
compare offers or check availability for a product
browse category nodes for product discovery
